name: Off-Road Vehicle
description: A vehicle propelled other than by muscular power or wind and designed to travel on no more than three wheels; an electric dirt bike like a Sur-Ron or Talaria ridden off-road is one, and an off-road motorcycle when on a highway, where separate rules govern it.

restrictions.rule: Propelled other than by muscular power or wind, on no more than three wheels; no limit on motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicles Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. O.4, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Needs a Ministry permit and number plate, which only an owner 16 or older can get, unless it already holds a Highway Traffic Act permit and plate
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicles Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. O.4, ss. 3(1), 5(1), 7

restrictions.rule: Must carry motor vehicle liability insurance, except on land its owner occupies
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicles Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. O.4, s. 15(1), (9)

restrictions.rule: Every rider must wear a helmet with the chin strap fastened, except on land its owner occupies
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicles Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. O.4, s. 19

restrictions.rule: Its owner may not let a child under 12 drive it, except on the owner's land or under an adult's close supervision
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicles Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. O.4, s. 4

restrictions.rule: The owner or occupier of the land may stop its driver
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicles Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. O.4, s. 17(2)

restrictions.rule: On a highway it's an off-road motorcycle (handlebars, two wheels, rims of at least 250 mm, a 1,016 mm wheelbase, a straddled seat, room for the driver only), allowed only on provincial highways listed for it, on municipal roads whose by-laws specifically permit off-road motorcycles, and on roads in the municipalities where the 80 km/h default limit applies unless a by-law prohibits it
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 191.8(1); O. Reg. 316/03, ss. 1, 4(2), 4.1

restrictions.rule: On a highway the driver needs a driver's licence past the G1 or M1 stage, a permit, plate and insurance, may carry no passengers, and may go no faster than 20 km/h where the limit is 50 km/h or less, or 50 km/h elsewhere
